svg.title: A non-stationary optimal policy
svg.desc: A grid with one column per corridor cell, 0 to 10, and one row per number of steps left, 1 at the bottom to 12 at the top. Cell 0 holds a plus-ten and cell 8 a plus-one; moving costs 0.1. Each square is coloured by the optimal action and shows the optimal value. With many steps left every cell from 1 to 7 heads left for the plus-ten; as the clock runs down, the cells nearest the plus-one switch to heading right, and cells that can reach neither goal in time stay still with value zero. Cells 9 and 10 always head left to the plus-one.
